name: AI PR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review, labeled]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  checks: read

concurrency:
  group: ai-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}${{ github.event.action == 'labeled' && format('-label-{0}', github.run_id) || '' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ai-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # The action also skips drafts and non-matching labels.
      - name: Check out the pull request head
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Run the AI review
        uses: misospace/pr-reviewer-action@5b1839535748f3afd1bd3ef04e8009302cba9aa6 # v3.7.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ai-base-url: ${{ secrets.AI_ENDPOINT }}
          ai-api-format: openai
          ai-model: review-model
          ai-max-tokens: "16384"
          ai-temperature: "0.1"
          ai-response-format: json_schema
          ai-api-key: ${{ secrets.MINIMAX_API_KEY }}

recorded_model_response.review_markdown:
## Summary

The workflow pins the action at commit 5b1839535748f3afd1bd3ef04e8009302cba9aa6 (tag v3.7.0) and passes the credential under an input name the pinned revision's metadata reportedly does not declare. The review checked that pin against the pinned revision's own metadata and implementation.

## Findings

- **Major** (.github/workflows/ai_pr_review.yaml:36) - the action at commit 5b1839535748f3afd1bd3ef04e8009302cba9aa6 declares its API-key input as `ai-key`, so `ai-api-key` is an unexpected input that GitHub ignores.
- **Major** (.github/workflows/ai_pr_review.yaml:20) - the action at commit 5b1839535748f3afd1bd3ef04e8009302cba9aa6 never skips drafts and never filters labels because its metadata declares no input for either gate.

## Recommendation

Request changes: rename the credential input and declare the draft/label gate inputs.
